criteria.rationale: The original prompt specifies a clear genre (romantic dance in vintage style) and aesthetic (sepia, soft focus). The enhanced prompt explicitly rejects these and replaces them with an incompatible, abstract, and contradictory scenario, violating GSF at the core.
